[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every open task has one computed task type (field, reading rule, [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]#task glyph. The words "theme" and "Pomodoro theme" become "task [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]type" everywhere a person reads them.[/#D7D7AF]
